Based on a search across all documents (contracts, pleadings, exhibits, correspondence, depositions), no document contains a Singapore-seated arbitration clause. The only arbitration clause found is in **msa-2019.pdf** (Section 14.3, page 17), which provides for arbitration seated in **London** under the LCIA Rules — not Singapore.

NOT FOUND — I searched all files for "Singapore," "SIAC," and "arbitrat*" and found no clause specifying Singapore as the arbitration seat. The only arbitration provision located is in contracts/msa-2019.pdf (p. 17, §14.3), which specifies London/LCIA, not Singapore.
